summary: Restroworks (rebranded from Posist in 2023) is a cloud-based unified restaurant technology platform, founded in 2012 by Ashish Tulsian and Sakshi Tulsian, now powering more than 20,000 restaurant locations globally.

Restroworks' unified POS/back-office platform is used by global restaurant chain brands including Taco Bell, Subway, Nando's, Buffalo Wild Wings, Caribou Coffee, Arby's, and Sbarro. (Scope note: Brand list reflects marketing/partnership claims; scope of deployment (which markets, how many locations per brand) is not independently broken out per brand in this source.)
Cockpit By Restroworks had a 3.6/5 App Store rating from 33 ratings at access.
The independently inspectable weakness evidence found for Restroworks was primarily app-level rather than a recurring enterprise POS implementation/support complaint corpus.
